prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1041; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in injuries to our client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured is represented by counsel or has a representative handling this claim, please forward this notice to them as well.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage is available.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or dashcam data, and any surveillance footage from the parking lot. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials while the claim is pending.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within ten business days.
